theme: A walled stage for a gala night

linkedin.text:
Some venues need lighting design to feel like an occasion. Others were built as fortifications and do it for free.

This is a fortified kasbah in southern Morocco, from a trip we produced. Walls that have been standing for centuries, a courtyard that holds a full group, and an entrance that does more for the mood than any welcome moment you could stage.

Historic sites come with a specific discipline. Nothing gets fixed to the walls. Power is brought in. The floor is uneven, which matters more than people expect once heels and service trays are involved. And the closing time is the closing time.

Work inside those limits and the result is an evening nobody compares to a hotel. Ignore them and you find out at load-in.

Want a venue with real history behind it in 2026? Tell us your dates and group size.
